hooks fixture

Each group holds the same readers: what follows --color-primary (a link, a checkbox, a text field, a native button and a .button), what follows --color-accent (a progress bar), a span for each of the other three roles reading its hook with its hue as the fallback, as a consumer does, and a span for each role's hue. The first group sets no hook; each of the next five sets one role's hook on its subtree; the seventh sets v0.3.0's two hook names; the last sets no hook inside a palette and scheme scope of its own.
